scenes.subject: A mature, lush coastal garden in front of a grey cedar-shingle New England house: blue and white hydrangeas, ornamental grasses, a low dry-stone fieldstone wall, a bluestone path; the ocean and a pale sky beyond
scenes.cues: weathered shingles, white trim, fieldstone, hydrangeas, beach roses, sea glimpse
scenes.camera: 24-35mm, eye level from the lawn, deep focus
scenes.light: late-afternoon golden light, soft haze over the water
scenes.composition: Garden and house in the right 60%; left 40% is calm sky and soft lawn with no detail (headline space)
scenes.exclusions: no people, no text, no house numbers, no signs, no cars

scenes.subject: A garden designer (woman, early 30s, rolled sleeves, canvas apron) walking a coastal property with a couple in their 50s, pointing toward a planting bed; she holds a clipboard turned away from camera
scenes.cues: friendly, unhurried, real conversation; shingle house and stone wall behind
scenes.composition: People in the right two-thirds; left third soft lawn and hedge
scenes.exclusions: no readable paper, no logos on clothing, no posed smiles at the camera

scenes.subject: Close-up of a stonemason's gloved hands setting a flat fieldstone into a half-built dry-stone wall; more stones stacked nearby
scenes.cues: granite and fieldstone, grass, dirt, a mason's hammer on the ground
scenes.composition: Hands and stone on the left half; right side a soft blur of wall and grass
scenes.exclusions: no faces needed, no text on gloves or tools

scenes.subject: A finished bluestone patio with a round stone fire pit and teak outdoor chairs, a low fieldstone seat wall, garden beds and warm landscape lights glowing; a shingle house with lit windows behind
scenes.cues: inviting evening, a small fire, coastal planting
scenes.light: blue hour with warm firelight and path lights
scenes.composition: Patio centre-right; top-left sky darkening and calm
scenes.exclusions: no people, no text, no brand names on furniture

scenes.subject: A crew member (man, 20s, plain sage-green work shirt) pruning a big hydrangea hedge with hand shears; a second worker raking in the background; a neat lawn
scenes.cues: care and attention, tidy property, canvas tool bag
scenes.light: fresh morning light with slight mist
scenes.composition: Subject on the left third; right side open lawn and hedge
scenes.exclusions: no logos or lettering on shirts, no visible brand names on tools

scenes.subject: A curving fieldstone path through ornamental grasses and lavender, lined with small warm path lights; the shingled corner of a house and a lit doorway at the end
scenes.composition: Path leads up the frame; top third is calm dusk sky and roofline
scenes.exclusions: no text, no house numbers, no people

scenes.subject: A two-generation family at a plant nursery among potted hydrangeas and shrubs: a father in his late 60s with grey hair, his adult daughter (30s) and son (30s) in work clothes, talking and laughing; a plain white pickup truck partly visible behind
scenes.cues: warm, genuine, proud of their work, coastal nursery greenhouse
scenes.composition: Family centre-right; left side soft plants and greenhouse
scenes.exclusions: no lettering on the truck or clothes, no famous or real people, not looking straight at the camera

scenes.subject: Close detail of coastal planting: dune grass, pink beach roses and sea lavender in front of a weathered grey cedar-shingle wall
scenes.cues: salt-tolerant plants, texture of shingles, a hint of sand
scenes.light: bright soft sun with sea breeze movement
scenes.composition: Plants in the lower two-thirds; upper third soft shingle texture
